title: Kaiming Initialization
hint: For fan_in mode: std = sqrt(2 / fan_in) where fan_in = weight.shape[1]. Fill with normal(0, std). Return the tensor.

description.text: Implement Kaiming (He) normal initialization: fill a 2D weight matrix in-place with samples from Normal(0, std^2) where std = sqrt(2 / fan_in). fan_in is weight.shape[1] for a typical linear weight.

examples.output: Entries ~ N(0, 2/fan_in); suitable default init for ReLU-style layers.
examples.explanation: Variance scales with fan-in so activations stay stable at init.

constraints: Initialize in-place; return the same tensor.
std = sqrt(2 / fan_in) with fan_in = weight.shape[1] for 2D weights.
Use torch.randn scaled by std (or equivalent).
